implementation.behavior: The fixed Win32 bridge captures foreground HWND/PID/process creation time, reads helper identity, reads clipboard sequence, and calls AllowSetForegroundWindow only after the exact live READY identity and foreground host are revalidated for each paste intent. Helper profile identity is derived from the Electron userData path.
